Author: Rayyan Aquino
Message:
fix: give the smoke test a placeholder credential

The pnpm-install fix worked (deps resolve, ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND is gone),
but surfaced a second, pre-existing issue: CouncilService/P10Service
construct eagerly at process startup (index.ts top level, not lazily on
first tool call), so createAnthropicClient() throws immediately with no
credential configured at all — this is documented, intended behavior
(CLAUDE.md's MCP Server section already said "exits on startup if no
credentials are present"), not a new bug. An earlier claim this session
that credential checks are deferred until tool-call time was wrong.

The smoke test only needs to prove the launch command resolves and the
process runs — it never calls a tool, so a placeholder (non-empty,
never-real) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY satisfies the assertion without any actual
network access.

Verified end-to-end locally: fresh install, node_modules stripped,
placeholder credential — install completes in 1.5s, server starts and
stays alive.

Author: Rayyan Aquino
Message:
fix(mcp-server): bundle dist/index.js with esbuild so a fresh install needs no node_modules

CI caught a real defect that three review passes (two P10 Arbiter
passes, one Safety Car adversarial review) all missed: committing
plain tsc output was never sufficient for a build-free launch. tsc
transpiles, it doesn't bundle - dist/index.js still had bare-specifier
imports (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @anthropic-ai/sdk,
@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @toto-wolff/core). A genuinely fresh
install (CI's git clone, no node_modules) threw ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
on launch. Local "verified end-to-end" testing earlier in this PR's
history reused this dev worktree's own already-installed
node_modules, which masked exactly this failure mode.

packages/mcp-server's build script now runs esbuild --bundle
--platform=node --format=esm --allow-overwrite on the tsc output,
in place, with a createRequire banner (the standard fix for
node-fetch, a transitive dep of pi-coding-agent, calling require()
in a way the ESM-output shim can't statically convert - verified by
reproducing the exact failure without the banner first, then
confirming it's gone with it).

Verified by direct execution, not just re-running CI locally: copied
the resulting dist/index.js alone into an empty directory with zero
node_modules anywhere on its path, launched it with the same
placeholder-credential/TOTO_MCP_PORT=0 conditions the CI smoke test
uses, confirmed it boots and stays alive. Confirmed determinism
(three independent rebuilds, byte-identical). packages/core/dist is
unchanged - unbundled, since core is never launched directly, only
imported by mcp-server's new bundle and by packages/cli (a local dev
tool, not part of the plugin's declared runtime surface).

Known, non-blocking, deliberately deferred: committed
packages/mcp-server/dist/ still also contains ~18 individually
tsc-compiled .test.js files (importing vitest) alongside the new
bundle, dead weight now, pre-existing since Stage 1, not introduced
here. Out of scope for this fix (touches the shared composite
project-reference graph); flagged for a follow-up.

Findings recorded: Safety-Car/2026-09-27-plugin-deployment-infra-redesign.md
(new "F11" section), P10-Plans/2026-09-27-plugin-deployment-infra-redesign.md
execution log.
